service.description: The header and metadata of the PMTiles archive at a resource location (location#versionName for a version), read by range (the 127-byte header, then the metadata where it says) and checked: version 3, the zoom range, the bounds, every section within the file and the root directory within its first 16 KiB, tiles of vector (mvt) or image type, directories gzipped or not compressed, metadata that is a JSON object (naming its vector layers for vector tiles). found false when nothing is there; each reason a map cannot draw it in problems, and valid true only when there is none. Writes nothing. It reads whatever location it is given, so it is MAPS_ADMIN's; register#ArchiveLayer and the readiness checks call it.

parameter.name: tag
parameter.description: The strong tag the storage reads it with; empty for a file on disk

parameter.name: header

service.description: A GeoJSON, GPX or KML file read as a map overlay (plans/Maps.md §4.1, §8; moqui-lib geo/overlay.rs): at a resource location (read as the framework) or given as text, at most maxBytes, at most maxFeatures features, WGS84 or a GeoJSON file's declared EPSG:3857 (converted; any other CRS refused), each feature's geometry checked by itself (one that is not sane is left out, counted and named in notes), labels and descriptions made plain text, and no KML network link, image overlay, style, icon or other reference followed (each counted in notes). Answers a sanitized GeoJSON FeatureCollection (geojson, unless summaryOnly) with featureCount, rejectedCount, bounds and crs; a file that cannot be an overlay is valid false with reasonCode (FORMAT_UNKNOWN, NOT_FOUND, NOT_READ, NOT_TEXT, TOO_LARGE, NOT_PARSED, NOT_FORMAT, CRS_UNSUPPORTED, TOO_MANY_FEATURES, NO_FEATURES) and reason. Writes nothing. It reads whatever location it is given, so no group is granted it: the overlay services (MapOverlays.js) call it after their own check of the caller's drive access.

parameter.name: format
parameter.description: MLF_GEOJSON, MLF_GPX or MLF_KML; else by fileName's extension

service.description: Register the archive of a PMTiles layer (format MLF_PMTILES_VECTOR or MLF_PMTILES_RASTER), at resourceLocation (the layer's own when empty), as the revision maps read. On storage that keeps versions (git://, dbresource://) the current version is recorded (sourceVersionName), so a later write does not change what a map reads until the layer is registered again; the content address of that version is the revision (sourceRevision, sourceTag, sourceSize, sourceAddressKind: an LFS object's oid, a content blob's or a small file's SHA-256). A file on disk has none: its SHA-256 is read once, with its modification time. Refused, the layer unchanged: a caller who may not change Maps › Configuration (PERMISSION_DENIED); a layer that is not a PMTiles one (FORMAT_NOT_ARCHIVE); a location with # or ?, or a folder (LOCATION_INVALID); nothing there (SOURCE_GONE); storage not known to read by range (STORAGE_NOT_RANGED: an archive is kept on disk, in dbresource:// or in git); in a git repository, a file that is not a Git LFS object (NOT_LFS: any other git object is read whole for every request); a header a map cannot draw (ARCHIVE_INVALID, with each of problems); tiles not of the layer's format (TILE_TYPE_MISMATCH). Records the drive the location is under (driveId), whose access a viewer needs too, the archive's zoom range and bounds, its attribution and version when the layer has none, and enables the layer. notes: what the archive's size meets (the upload limit, an LFS object's, its drive's quota). A new revision is replaced (replaced true): a map drawing the old one is refused it (409) and loads its configuration again.

Whether the current user may read a registered archive layer at a revision now, for the map-source transition on every request (GET, HEAD, each range), writing nothing (no ResourceRecent): the layer enabled, PMTiles and registered (SOURCE_MISSING, SOURCE_NOT_REGISTERED: 404), its viewPermission held (one not held is SOURCE_MISSING), its provider enabled (PROVIDER_DISABLED), and at least view on its drive at its path (FileServices get#DriveAccess: a member, or a share of the file or a folder above it; SOURCE_NOT_PERMITTED, 403, so a revoked share or a removed member is refused at the next request). A revision that is not the registered one (REVISION_CHANGED) and a file on disk changed since it was registered (SOURCE_CHANGED) are 409, so the map loads its configuration again. When ok: the location to send (location#versionName on storage that keeps versions) with the registered tag and size, for ec.web.sendPinnedResourceResponse. Every signed-in user may call it (MAPS_DIALOG): it checks the layer and the drive itself.

The PMTiles layers for Maps › Configuration › Archives, for a caller who may open Configuration (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise): each with its location, registered revision, version, size, zoom range, drive, the profiles whose basemap it is, its state now (ready; NOT_REGISTERED; NEWER_REVISION, a later revision stored but not registered; SOURCE_CHANGED, SOURCE_GONE, NOT_LFS, STORAGE_NOT_RANGED) and what its size meets; and the limits (max-upload, git-server@lfs-max-object-size and max-object-size, resource-facade@pinned-max-age). Changes nothing.

The maps.archives readiness provider (data/AdminConfigurationData.xml), changing nothing, for a caller with ADMIN_OVERVIEW_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise): each PMTiles layer with a location, enabled or registered, as find#ArchiveLayers states it (NOT_REGISTERED and NEWER_REVISION warnings; NOT_LFS, a git archive that is not a Git LFS object, refused by name, SOURCE_CHANGED, SOURCE_GONE and STORAGE_NOT_RANGED failed); NO_ARCHIVES when there is none.
